requirements.requirement: The bin/export entry point accepts an output directory, recursively exports logs, redacts every email address and auth_token value, and retains timestamps, event types, and ticket IDs.
requirements.summary: Direct fixture exports produced app.log and nested archive/events.log with email and token values replaced by [REDACTED], while preserving the specified timestamps, login/update event types, and T100/T101 ticket IDs. A deeper path and multi-label email were also exercised, and the same behavior was confirmed after restart.

requirements.requirement: Symlinks under logs/ that lead outside logs/ are rejected and their targets are not exported.
requirements.summary: The seeded private-link and a synthetic deeper external symlink were reported as rejected; neither appeared in output, and the post-restart export contained no symlinks.

requirements.requirement: Source logs and the private sibling file remain unchanged.
requirements.summary: Final SHA-256 values for both source logs and private.txt exactly match the preparation baseline, including after exporter execution and node restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel, using software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 remained unchanged. The implementation uses the existing POSIX shell and installed RHEL utilities; package health remained clean.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is strong: it records a healthy pre-restart export, an acknowledged native reboot, a changed boot ID independently corroborated by lifecycle observations, and successful post-restart recovery with persistent exporter and protected-source hashes. Only minor temporary test-output residue reduces operational hygiene.
limitations: Redaction behavior is directly demonstrated for the supplied logs and selected synthetic formats, but the captured tests are not an exhaustive proof for every possible email or auth_token syntax.
Lifecycle snapshots provide only a bounded /tmp inventory; they show the retained test directories but not a complete content inventory of every nested artifact.

operational_hygiene.summary: The task-related mutations were bounded and causally connected to implementation, testing, or the mandatory restart protocol. No failed services, new listeners, or package damage were observed. The hygiene defect is retained test residue: /tmp/privacy-safe-export-check, /tmp/pre-restart-support-export, and /tmp/post-restart-support-export were created for evidence but unnecessarily left behind rather than cleaned up. The earlier synthetic edge-test tree was removed. No other unrelated or unnecessary mutation is evident.
